## Experimental strata — do not pool
A. **Legacy regression**: exact original Phase A byte SHA; optionally re-run downloaded historical code but not replace original stone.
B. **Unified synthetic source and competing models**: same 81 persistent digital site identities, 27 waves, 4 illumination arms `dark, short, long, continuous_then_dark`, 240 ticks, two models `C/O/R` and `C1/O1/O2/C2`, same time base dt=20ms, integer scale Q=1,000,000, same deterministic synthetic pulse schedule and target; arbitrary reference rates declared in model code (NOT fitted to biological observations). `81*27*4*240*2=4,199,040` synthetic site updates; 7 checkpoints (ticks 0,7,31,63,127,191,239) * 27*4*2 = 1,512 whole-81-site snapshots. Store checkpoint bytes and full sha. Tests: mass nonnegative+Q, darkness null, on/off recovery, no per-tick authorizations, independent Python/Node byte parity on Ubuntu+Windows. Define current proxy `I3=2000*O` and `I4=2000*O1+500*O2` (synthetic integer arbitrary units); cannot compare current magnitude to biology without calibration.
C. **Memory payload correctness**: take a 65,536-byte deterministic (non-secret) synthetic payload derived from fixed algorithm and explicit SHA. Split into two equal 32,768-byte shards A,B and parity P=A XOR B, producing three separate *digital* memory sticks. Any two reconstruct exact payload with SHA; any single shard can neither reconstruct unique arbitrary payload nor authenticate itself. Full hashes and index/length/epoch/source metadata required. Encoding in a single RGB QR is *independent*: packetize reconstructed full source into 2100-byte indexed chunks using the exact August protocol (32 chunks -> 11 RGB composite QR frames). Test index reorder; missing chunks; duplicate index; one-channel loss; bad payload; stale/forged SHA; incorrect RGB grayscale conversion. For actual QR render+decode use independent available open-source QR libraries (or record NOT_EXECUTED), do NOT count pure packet simulation as actual optical QR readback. QR is a visual channel; image displayed on screen or saved as PNG isn't persistent photonic storage.
D. **GF(2)/information loss**: test parity reconstruction of arbitrary bytes, compare address-only digest versus full payload; SHA256 is a commitment, NOT an inverse or a signature. Do not claim XOR yields information-theoretic secrecy or authenticates a source. Require challenge mutation to be HELD.
E. **Provenance/fault semantics**: frozen source/fixture digest is independent of the tested producer and watcher. Corrupt state/site/epoch/frame/chunk/nonce/source, coherently forge source+watcher, duplicate chunk, remove two shards, delay feedback. Record stage/attack_exercised/terminal decision; no watcher -> W NOT_APPLICABLE. Differences from old #39 E fault injection semantics cannot be pooled.
F. **Control economics**: compare fixed vs optimized open-loop vs zero-delay and delayed feedback within the *same* reference model/law/schedule, account for light-on commands, prereg optimizer search and test split, no energy efficiency inference without calibrated power.
